text: {"lessons":["The account declined over these periods, but random past price moves do not reliably predict what comes next; I should avoid reacting to short-term fluctuations.","Selling Stock D and E at gains felt rewarding, but a realized gain alone is not a reason to sell; I should base each trade on a consistent plan.","Holding through every decline is not automatically prudent either: I should periodically reassess my positions objectively, without letting loss aversion or reluctance to admit a mistake dictate my choices."]}
